description: This file defines an abstract class 'kintParser' which is responsible for parsing various PHP data types and objects into a structured representation. It includes methods for interpreting arrays, objects, primitives, resources, and strings, as well as handling recursion, depth limits, and external dependencies for custom and object parsers.

classes.name: kintParser
classes.description: An abstract class providing static and protected methods for parsing and representing PHP variables, including handling of recursive structures, custom data types, object properties, and various primitive types.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes custom data and object parsers by requiring PHP files from specific directories.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets parser state including depth level and object tracking.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Main static method to parse a variable into a structured representation, handling recursion, type-specific parsing, and alternative representations.

methods.name: _checkDepth
methods.description: Checks if the maximum parsing depth is reached.

methods.name: _isArrayTabular
methods.description: Determines if an array can be represented as a tabular structure.

methods.name: _decorateCell
methods.description: Wraps a variable's display in an HTML table cell, with styling for alternatives or extended values.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string value for safe HTML display, applying encoding and character replacements.

methods.name: _parse_array
methods.description: Parses an array, handling recursion, depth, and tabular representation, generating extended HTML output if applicable.

methods.name: _parse_object
methods.description: Parses an object, including its properties and reflection data, with recursion detection and link generation for user-defined classes.

methods.name: _parse_boolean
methods.description: Parses a boolean value into a string representation.

methods.name: _parse_double
methods.description: Parses a double (float) value into a string.

methods.name: _parse_integer
methods.description: Parses an integer value into a string.

methods.name: _parse_resource
methods.description: Parses a resource, such as streams, providing type and metadata.

methods.name: _parse_string
methods.description: Parses a string, including size, encoding detection, truncation, and extended views.

methods.name: _parse_unknown
methods.description: Handles unknown data types by exporting their var_export representation.
